crossRefs.note: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz…
So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did what Yahweh commanded them, and…
After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

people.name: Eliphaz
people.line: A Temanite, one of Job's three friends.

people.name: Teman
people.line: Grandson of Esau, associated with an Edomite clan

translations.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
translations.asv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
